searchText: the first time i probably would told colangelo to fuck off. over a tweet about a pizza party. then i woulda told you to not do that, privately. tigers don’t need to know. second time, i probably would told colangelo that‘s something we shouldn’t be doing and we’d handle it internally. and then i probably woulda been like you really got to stop doing that cause it’s not a good look for you or the paper. but i don’t think it warrants removal from a beat. maybe, hey, take a few days and work on a story to let it cool down with the team. freep dave birkett
